title: Text reveal
description: A headline that arrives word by word, each word rising into place. Settles once, then stays.
usage: For one headline per page — the hero, a section opening. The script splits the text into words; the stagger is 45ms per word and the whole thing runs once.
a11y: Without the script, the text is simply text. Screen readers read the original sentence; reduced-motion users get it static.
